concept.reason: Actual original skull, whole skeleton and comparative foot-bearing congener figures inspected, quantitative original description sufficient without extra concept image.

scope: Whole robust low-bodied mammal with a large head and strong jaws, reconstructed mainly from IVPP V14155, with explicitly comparative hand/foot reconstruction from congeneric R.robustus.

scientific_limits.en: V14155 preserves partial skull and articulated postcranium, but lacks manus and pes. Short broad plantigrade hands/feet are inferred using R.robustus V13605, not directly preserved in the modeled individual. Fur, ears, color and flesh are inferred. Tail364mm is preserved length, not certified complete tail. Mass12-14kg is regression estimate. Dinosaur stomach remains belong to R.robustus, not V14155.
scientific_limits.zh: V14155保存部分颅骨与关联骨架，但手足缺失。短宽跖行手足按同属R.robustus V13605比较推断，并非目标个体实证。毛、耳、颜色及软组织为复原；364毫米是保存尾长，非完整尾长保证。12至14千克为回归估计；恐龙胃内容物属于R.robustus，不属于V14155。

classification: Eutriconodonta, Mammalia; extinct non-therian mammal, not a modern badger or rodent

scale.model_status: Fleshed head/tail/shoulder are conservative original estimates; trunk follows published dimension. Overall about1.087m, not claimed exact living measurement.

diagnostic_targets: Low long robust torso with short stout semi-erect limbs, not long-legged running dog or extremely sprawling lizard.
Large elongate heavy head with thick mandible and broad rear cheek/temporal volume; no tiny shrew head or modern blunt pug face.
Strong neck continuous with substantial shoulders, distinguish jaw depth from body mass.
Short broad plantigrade feet inferred from congener; small separated toes/claws, no hooves or flippers.
Long tapering cylindrical tail, not Castorocauda paddle or a modern badger short stump.
Neutral inferred fur and small rounded ears; no modern badger mask, striped back or asserted fossil coat pattern.
acceptance: Full whole-organism original scope, robust low body plus large strong-jawed head must be jointly readable.
Side preserves long torso/short limbs and deep jaw; top/perspective broad strong head and neck.
Feet have support and negative spaces, tail is tapering not paddle-shaped.
Distinguish species-specific measurements from congeneric feet and inferred soft tissues.
Exactly four exactGLB views, two isolated rebuilds, independent review.
